nom: Lancer Skincare Caviar Lime Acid Peel

avis.texte: I've been using this once a week for a few years now. My skin feels smooth and super clean after each use. I'm so glad Ultra is carrying this line now.
This makes my skin feel so soft. I absolutely love every lancer product I have. Secondly recommend this.
I love this product. It keeps my skin smooth and helps with sun spots.
This is a great treatment I use it weekly and it makes my skin soft and smooth. Definitely a staple le in my skin care routine

This is the very product I was waiting to get! I have a dark brown patch in my left cheek that brings unwanted looks to my face. I am visibly shaken up by the states I get from this dark brown patch. This acid peel may be the very product that helps that. We shall see!
I really like this! I use it twice a week to reveal a natural glow and smooth skin.
This resets your skin; it deep-cleans and opens it up, and makes it feel smooth. Your skin is ready for the next step. Over time, I think it lightens the skin tone and evens it out.
Effective product with an amazing & professional results. It's like having a dermatologist procedure but at home! Highly recommended.
This is an excellent product for my skin. I like to apply this as a mask and sleep overnight in it.
Love this peel!! Absolutely saw a difference after one use. It also smells divine!!

The first time I used this product my skin was sensitive to it. It wasn't too bad, but I did notice some uncomfortable tingling in small areas on my face. No breakouts and it only lasted about 15 minutes. Gave myself a week before I tried again and it was fine. It's now one of my favorites and I use it every Sunday. My skin has become more radiant and I've noticed less wrinkles.
Love this! It was my introduction to Lancer and I'm now a convert to many of the products. This mask was awesome! Doesn't burn, my skin was NOTICEABLY less discolored and brighter.
Love love love this peel!!! Love the scent, love the way it makes my skin feel and I absolutely love the glow it gives my skin!!!

This peel is such an enjoyable sensory experience, leaving your skin super smooth, not irritated or tight afterwards. I use it once a week and follow up with the nourish cream, and it never fails to leave my skin feeling like new.
My skin feels brand new the next day. I've never found a better peel. This is my absolute fav!
This peel really works! Makes your skin feel super smooth! I'm using weekly and feel this is the same as a light chemical peel in a med spa!
The caviar lime acid peel absolutely makes your skin glow afterwards. I steam first for about five minutes and then my skin is very clean and the caviar lime makes it even better.
I love how soft my skin feels after! I love using it every week!

The Caviar Lime Acid Peel is a must-have for me in my skin care routine. It honestly does make a difference with fine lines. My skin is very sensitive, but I have never had any issues with the Caviar Lime Peel. Use it once a week and love the results I get.

Oh this stuff is too good! Leave it on for the full hour the night before a big day & your skin will be radiant for your big event! It's really amazing how well it does it's job. I don't ever want to be without it again!
I love this product. I use it a couple times a week and can see the difference the next morning
My first time using this product. I used it sparingly. No stinging. It was very pleasant. My skin feels so soft now. I will use it again in a couple of days.
This product works extremely well on combination skin as well as aging skin. Gives your skin new life!!
I really liked the feel of my skin after using this product. Will be coming back for more!

This makes my skin so smooth and flawless for makeup. I've fought years from being a teenager in the early 90s where skincare wasn't much talked about like it is now. I slept in makeup and have old acne scars. I can't live without this.
I truly feel using this product over the years has improve my skin and has help reduced the sun damage and aging process if not turning back some time,
This is sooooo refreshing and it brightens up your skin tone so beautifully
Haven't seen the results yet. Scent is pleasant. No stinging.
This peel cream is amazing, my skin looks so much better after using this. Highly recommend

This peel is the real deal. It's pricey but it's worth it. It lasts a long time and you feel the difference in your skin right away. It feels soft and looks even. I just noticed my jar was almost empty and I had a little panic attack. Get it- you won't regret it!
Luv this Xavier peel my skin feels& looks amazing I do this twice a week,won't b w/out this & I use quite a lot of lancer skin products luv them all
Very expensive for my pocket, but it was very worth the use. Smooth, luxurious, left my face feeling clean and hydrated.
I love this product. Always feel refreshed after using and my skin is super soft.
it seems improving the overall skin texture. I use it twice a week.
My neighbor uses your products and gifted me a small sample to try and needless to say I love it. It's my favorite exfoliator for my 56 year old skin
I use the peel 2-3 times a week and I have noticed a huge difference in my skin. It is much more softer, my pores are smaller and complexion is clearer. I will continue this product!
This product is amazing! I was very nervous to use it because my skin is so sensitive, but it's wonderful! I had no reaction issues and my skin felt so soft and even after use

THE BEST HANDS DOWN..... IT MAKES YOU FEEL NEW EVERY YOU USE IT.. LEAVES YOUR SKIN FLAWLESS... CAN NOT DO WITHOUT!!! SMELLS AMZING ...JUST A GREAT PRODUCTS... I USE ALL THE LINE PRODUCTS FOR BOTH FACE AND BODY
Absolute favorite product! I have dry skin and can't live without this product! I use the pads through the week and a mask on Saturday nights.

Every time I use this peel, my skin feels amazing the next day. It has a beautiful glow to it. It really is a noticeable difference. I wish I could use it everyday, but it's probably a bit too harsh for everyday use. It's perfect for a skin beautifying boost once a week!

avis.titre: Past texture issues from acne drastically improved
avis.texte: I have used high end and low end and all in between. With the cleanser, polish and nourish and the caviar lime peel. My face is so refreshed and smooth. Also a redhead that can tan. No sensitivity to this peel. Nothing has ever compared to how great this works. Everyone notices and says how great my skin looks.
I love the products. Can definitely tell a difference in my skin's texture.
I have noticed a difference in my skin after using this consistently over time.
I love this Stuff! I leave it on a little longer and it leaves my skin looking like I just had a facial. It's one of my favorite Lancer products.

I was afraid to use it but now I can't be without it! I have enlarged pores and fine lines as a 54 yr old female but it install smooths my face and I was shocked! It really works! Not a fan of the smell but it's so worth it
Absolutely LOVE Caviar Lime Acid Peel!!! My skin is so hydrated after using it.

This is a great peel for renewing my face and getting any dry, old skin off. I usually leave it on longer than I'm supposed to but it doesn't irritate my skin like other enzyme peels I've used in the past. My skin is a brighter and smoother afterwards. This is definitely my favorite peel.

I was a bit skeptical about this product because I have sensitive skin, but I've heard of so many people saying that it's amazing and they have no regrets. I agree! I got the courage to try it and I love it. My skin feels better and I notice a difference. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed!
I love how my face "glows" after I use the Caviar Lime Peel without any irritation. My makeup goes on seamlessly . Definitely worth a try. Oh, and it smells great!!
This is my favorite peel, it always leaves my skin looking so smooth.

This product is like having a facial treatment at home. It even has a nice subtle citrus smell. I've noticed results of a smoother appearance to my skin as well as lightening of dark spots. The shipping is always on time and everything is packaged so well. I look forward to the treat of my "at home facial" during the week.
This leaves my face super smooth. It has a super mild, fresh, citrus smell. Loving the results. Highly recommend.
This is the best mask for my skin. It's great for sensitivity and it really brightens up my face.
This product leaves my skin feeling very clean and refreshed!
This is a must have! Works after just 1 use! Baby soft skin. Non-irritating for sensitive skin types. The on the go travel size is smaller than I was anticipating.

Don't let this product fool you! The first time I used it I loved the smell, the light texture, and how smoothly it went on to my skin. No burn or irritation so I figured it probably wouldn't do much.., WOW! Was I wrong! My skin felt so soft and smooth after I used it! Also, my makeup looks more polished and I get more compliments on my skin then ever before !

I love it! I noticed a difference within the first week. I love using the cleanser, and I sometimes use the polish as a spot treatment for active acne - it diminishes the size by a whole lot! I also noticed less cystic acne and less congestion. I added the caviar lime acid peel to use every other day - and my skin even tolerates it if I leave it on for 1 hour. It feels smooth and clean afterwards.
This is amazing. Smells great. I thought it would burn but it didn't; just a little tingle. Left my face feeling much smoother. I use it about two times per week or every three days.

I recently had my 50th birthday with my family and my sister who I have seen within the last month and a half noticed a difference in the smoothness of my skin. I had only used the caviar and lime peel 3 times- that's pretty amazing!!
One of my all time favorite products!! The difference in my skin everytime I use it is remarkable. I use it 2 or 3 times a week.

At first I did not know if I could use this product as I have sensitive/combination skin, but now I cannot live without it. I use once a week and apply to the tzone. It clears my skin of any residues. I leave on about 7-10 minutes and afterwards my skin feels so amazing. The scent is also unbelievable and I am VERY sensitive to any scents. This product is a must!
So far so good. Still using the product and it's too soon to tell the results; but so far my skin is feeling good.
I love this peel! Every time I use it my sister asks what I've done because my makeup goes on so much smoother! I will continue to use this product!

This product is next level. It is so highly effective and just continues to give great results time after time. I usually leave it on a bit longer than recommended and do it at night before bed. The next day my skin looks (and feels) amazing. Thank you for such a brilliant product Dr Lancer.

Smells amazing. Feels good on my skin. Great value for rhe money. A little goes a long way. It seems like a small container, but it really doesn't take much. Perfect size for travel. No peeling or flaking of my skin. Washes off smoothly after 15 minutes. Will continue to use.
This peel is high quality and is awesome. I use it 2x per week. The tingling is worth it. This keeps my skin soft, refreshed, and even. Love it!
feels really nice,but so far didn't notice to much difference. Maybe i need something a bit stronger
This was a free sample included in my purchase but it does feel great on the skin and leaves my skin soft after use.
Love this! My skin was noticeably softer and glowed afterward and the lime scent was very refreshing and pleasant.
I will definitely purchase the larger size of this product, with minimal effort my face looks and feels or even toned and soft.
So far I like the acid peel, have used it for about a month. Face feels and looks great. Will do another review after using it longer.
For awhile I quit using it because I didn't want to wait to rinse it off. I decided to try using a small amount like a night cream. I just wash in the morning. 2x a week and it is amazing.
Awesome. This removes any impurities, shrinks my pours and makes my face feel renewed and refreshed would highly recommend it. Love it.
I can tell such a difference when I use the caviar lime acid peel. Skin looks fresh and bright. I gave my daughter a sample and she liked it a lot as well.
I love this mask it works wonders on my skin. I also use it on my hands and chest.

I received this peel in a giveaway gift basket from Dr. Lancer. It smells fresh, feels smooth on my fingers and my skin, tingles on my face but just a little and I love the pink jar. Dr. Lancer's products always make my skin feel amazing! Thank you!
I like how this product feels on my skin, I also like how my skin feels after washing the acid peel off.
